name: Communist Party of India (Marxist)
founders: Leaders who left the Communist Party of India at the 7th Congress in Calcutta, including E. M. S. Namboodiripad, Jyoti Basu and P. Sundarayya
mission: Describes itself as a Marxist–Leninist party working for socialism, through a 'people's democracy' led by the working class.

leaders.name: E. M. S. Namboodiripad
leaders.role: Chief Minister of Kerala; General Secretary

events.title: First elected communist state government (CPI)
events.body: E. M. S. Namboodiripad becomes Chief Minister of Kerala, before the party split.

events.title: Formed after the CPI split
events.body: A group leaves the Communist Party of India and forms the CPI(M).

events.title: Left Front government in West Bengal
events.body: Jyoti Basu becomes Chief Minister; the Left Front governs the state until 2011.

events.title: Supports the UPA government from outside
events.body: Left parties back the Manmohan Singh government without joining it.

events.title: Withdraws support over the nuclear deal
events.body: The Left withdraws support over the India–US civil nuclear agreement.

events.title: Pinarayi Vijayan becomes Chief Minister of Kerala
events.body: The LDF wins again in 2021, the first back-to-back win in Kerala in decades.

promises.text: Raise welfare pensions to ₹2,500 a month in phases.
K-FON: free internet for poor families.
20 lakh jobs for educated young people.

name: Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam
mission: Describes itself as a social-justice party of the Dravidian movement, focused on self-respect, state autonomy and the Tamil language.

leaders.name: C. N. Annadurai
leaders.role: Founder; Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu

leaders.name: M. Karunanidhi
leaders.role: Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu (five terms)

events.title: Founded in Madras
events.body: C. N. Annadurai founds the DMK after leaving the Dravidar Kazhagam.

events.title: Forms the state government
events.body: Annadurai becomes Chief Minister of Madras State (renamed Tamil Nadu in 1969).

events.title: M. Karunanidhi becomes Chief Minister
events.body: After Annadurai's death.

events.title: M. K. Stalin becomes Chief Minister
events.body: The DMK-led alliance wins the 2021 assembly election.

promises.text: Free travel for women in ordinary town buses.
promises.note: Among the first orders after taking office in May 2021.

promises.text: ₹4,000 COVID-19 relief to every ration-card holder.
promises.note: Paid to 2.07 crore ration-card holders in 2021.

promises.text: ₹1,000 a month to women heads of families.
promises.note: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam launched in September 2023, limited to households earning under ₹2.5 lakh a year.

promises.text: Exempt Tamil Nadu from the NEET medical entrance exam.

name: Bahujan Samaj Party
mission: Describes its aim as political power for the 'Bahujan' (Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, OBCs and minorities), inspired by B. R. Ambedkar.

leaders.name: Mayawati
leaders.role: Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh (four terms); party president

events.title: Founded
events.body: Kanshi Ram founds the BSP on B. R. Ambedkar's birth anniversary.

events.title: Mayawati becomes Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh
events.body: India's first Dalit woman Chief Minister.

events.title: Wins a majority in Uttar Pradesh
events.body: The BSP forms a government on its own.

name: Samajwadi Party
mission: Describes itself as a socialist party in the tradition of Ram Manohar Lohia.

leaders.name: Mulayam Singh Yadav
leaders.role: Founder; Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh

leaders.name: Akhilesh Yadav
leaders.role: Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh; party president

events.title: Founded
events.body: Mulayam Singh Yadav founds the party in Lucknow.

events.title: Akhilesh Yadav becomes Chief Minister
events.body: The SP wins a majority in Uttar Pradesh.

events.title: Wins 37 Lok Sabha seats
events.body: The third-largest party in the 18th Lok Sabha.

promises.text: Free laptops for students who pass Class 12.
promises.note: Over 15 lakh laptops were given to Class 10 and 12 pass students between 2012 and 2015.

promises.text: Loans at 4% interest for small farmers.
Reservation for minorities.

name: All India Trinamool Congress
mission: Describes itself as a centre-left, regionalist party; its political slogan is 'Ma Mati Manush' (mother, land, people).
symbol: Twin flowers and grass (Jora Ghas Phul)

leaders.name: Mamata Banerjee
leaders.role: Founder; Chief Minister of West Bengal

events.title: Founded
events.body: Mamata Banerjee leaves the Congress and founds the party.

events.title: Ends 34 years of Left Front rule in West Bengal
events.body: Mamata Banerjee becomes Chief Minister.

promises.text: Lakshmir Bhandar: a monthly basic income for women heads of households.
Student credit cards for higher education loans.

name: Aam Aadmi Party
founders: Arvind Kejriwal and members of the India Against Corruption movement
mission: Describes its aim as clean governance and 'swaraj' (self-rule), born from the 2011 anti-corruption movement.

events.title: Founded
events.body: Formed by activists of the India Against Corruption movement.

events.title: First Delhi government
events.body: Arvind Kejriwal becomes Chief Minister; he resigns after 49 days.

events.title: Wins 67 of 70 seats in Delhi
events.body: Kejriwal becomes Chief Minister again.

events.title: Forms the government in Punjab
events.body: Bhagwant Mann becomes Chief Minister after the party wins 92 of 117 seats.

events.title: Recognised as a national party
events.body: By the Election Commission of India.

events.title: Loses the Delhi assembly election
events.body: The BJP wins a majority in Delhi.

promises.text: 300 units of free electricity a month for every household.
₹1,000 a month to every woman over 18.
Pass the Jan Lokpal Bill.
Doorstep delivery of rations.
24-hour piped water for every household.
Free bus rides for students.
Pucca houses for slum dwellers.
A pollution-free Delhi.
